name: Cloudial Date Input
description: A generic locale-aware Salesforce LWC date input with canonical ISO output, validation, native calendar selection, Flow support, and RTL layout.
features: Canonical YYYY-MM-DD value and event contract
Manual entry and native calendar picker
Nested LWC and Flow Screen support
whenToUse: Use when a Salesforce UI needs a reusable date-only field with stable ISO output and configurable presentation.
